description: ACCDB: 2mww draft Field Attributes & OrdinalPosition BEFORE TableDefs.Append: (1) TAttr: default Attributes read on Long/Text before Put, then ID Long Attributes=16 (dbAutoIncrField), F Long Attributes=1 (dbFixedField), V Text(10) Attributes=2 (dbVariableField); (2) TOrd: 3 fields A(OrdinalPosition=2), B(OrdinalPosition=0), C(OrdinalPosition=1) -> exact TDEF order, LvProp, and Fields enumeration; (3) TOrdSame: 3 fields X(OrdinalPosition=5), Y(OrdinalPosition=5), Z(default). Keeps all pages after each Append, pause, Close.
